notice: Independent research review only; never an eo-lifecycle-review/v1 certification.
rationale: Independent reading: held EO 11261 (30 FR 15397, Dec. 11, 1965) only substitutes a new sec. 304 in EO 10973 (USIA public-information functions; delegation of FAA secs. 221-222 informational media guaranty functions to the USIA Director); no own term, no independent operative text. Held EO 12163 (44 FR 56673) sec. 1-903(a)(1): 'The following are revoked: (1) Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended', effective Oct. 1, 1979 (sec. 1-905). Revocation of the parent 'as amended' removes the substituted sec. 304, so the order has nothing left to operate; independent status NO, agrees. Refutation attempts: sec. 1-904 continues delegations and actions 'except to the extent inconsistent with this order' and only those 'not revoked'; continuing the sec. 304(b) delegation contained in the revoked EO 10973 itself would be inconsistent with sec. 1-903(a)(1), so 1-904 preserves implementing actions, not the order's text (producer flagged this openly; I agree with the reading, residual note only). D6: walked EO 11417, 11579, 11685, 11816, 11959, 12118 (all amend other parts of EO 10973 or partly supersede it; none touches or revives sec. 304) and the EO 12163 revocation; no later instrument re-enacts sec. 304; corpus search finds EO 11261 named only in EO 11260/11261 pages. Nothing ended or changed was ignored. Accept.
